Name: Refill Silos
Author: Omegasis
Description:
Do you like animals? Do you not like calculating how much hay you need to refill your silos? Do you sometimes forget to put the hay you just bought into your silos leaving your poor animals hungry?

If you answered yes to any of those questions, then this mod may just be for you!

This mod adds a new "item" to be purchased from the animal shop, aka Marnie's Ranch, that allows you to buy enough hay to fill your silos, or as much as you can afford, and then automatically fills your silos with all of the hay you just bought. Gone are the days of having hungry animals again!

The price for hay calculation is the same as buying the hay individually, just multiplied by how many pieces of hay you would need to buy to refill your silos.
For example, if you need to buy 10 pieces, and the price of hay is 50 gold, then expect to pay 500 gold. Since the amount of hay you need at any given time varies, the price of purchasing the silo refill varies as well.

Note that if your silos are full, or you don't have any, the new item doesn't show up in the shop.

Downloads.Description: Updated to Stardew Valley 1.6.10. Fixed a bug that could occur where the player would receive the refill item, but their silos would not be refilled.
